title: NCO: A Versatile Plug-in for Handling Negative Constraints in Decoding
selection_reason: NCO performs online matching of hard/regex forbidden patterns during LLM decoding, avoiding combined-automaton state explosion and reducing computational overhead while supporting sampling, beam search and soft masks.
